title: Optimized Assembly and Gene Finding Protocol
author: Bonnie Hurwitz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gbhbsj6

steps.title: Initialize HPC Environment
steps.instruction: Log into the HPC and navigate to the class directory.

substeps.instruction: Login to the HPC and move to the ICE cluster (if meno is enabled, select option 3: ssh hpcice ssh hpc ice).
Change directory to the class directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username (replace 'username' with your actual user name).

steps.title: Create Analysis Directories
steps.instruction: Set up the directory structure for assembly, read recruitment, and gene finding.

substeps.instruction: Create the main analysis directories: mkdir assembly read_recruit gene_finding
Navigate to the assembly directory and create log directories: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly && mkdir std-err std-out

steps.title: Run Genome Assembly
steps.instruction: Create and execute a Megahit assembly script on the cluster.

substeps.instruction: Create a script named 'run-assembly.sh' with the following parameters: PBS group_list=bh_class, queue=windfall, select=1:ncpus=12:mem=23gb, pvmem=22gb, walltime=24:00:00, cput=24:00:00. Set FASTQ_DIR to '/rsgrps/bh_class/username/unmapped', ASSEM_DIR to '/rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly', MIN_CONTIG_LEN=500, and OUT_DIR to '/rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly/megahit-out'.
The script should use megahit with --preset meta-sensitive, --min-contig-len 500, and -t 12.
Make the script executable: chmod 755 run-assembly.sh
Submit the job: qsub -e std-err/ -o std-out/ run-assembly.sh

steps.title: Prepare Contigs for Indexing
steps.instruction: Simplify fasta headers of the resulting contigs using fastx_renamer.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the assembly output: cd ../assembly/megahit-out
Load the fastx module: module load fastx/0.0.14
Rename headers: fastx_renamer -n COUNT -i final.contigs.fa -o fixed-contigs.fa

steps.title: Build Contig Index
steps.instruction: Create a Bowtie2 index for the fixed contigs.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the index directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/read_recruit/bt2_index
Load the bowtie2 module: module load bowtie2/2.2.5
Build the index: bowtie2-build -f /rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly/megahit-out/fixed-contigs.fa contig_index

steps.title: Run Read Recruitment
steps.instruction: Align reads back to the assembly using Bowtie2 and process with Samtools.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the bam directory and create log folders: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/read_recruit/bam && mkdir std-err std-out

Create a script 'bt2_align.sh' with parameters: PBS group_list=bh_class, queue=windfall, jobtype=cluster_only, select=1:ncpus=4:mem=15gb, pvmem=14gb, place=pack:shared, walltime=24:00:00, cput=24:00:00.

Configure script paths: FASTQ_DIR='/rsgrps/bh_class/username/unmapped', BT2_INDEX='/rsgrps/bh_class/username/read_recruit/bt2_index/contig_index', OUT_DIR='/rsgrps/bh_class/username/read_recruit/bam', CONTIGS='/rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly/megahit-out/fixed-contigs.fa'.
The script must load bowtie2/2.2.5 and samtools/1.3.1, then run bowtie2 with -q --maxins 800 --fr --very-sensitive-local -p 4, followed by samtools view (-@ 16 -bT) and samtools sort (-@ 16).
Make the script executable: chmod 755 bt2_align.sh
Submit the job: qsub -e std-err/ -o std-out/ bt2_align.sh

steps.title: Run Gene Finding
steps.instruction: Identify genes in the assembly using Prodigal.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the gene_finding directory and create log folders: cd ../gene_finding && mkdir std-err std-out

Create a script 'run-prodigal.sh' with parameters: PBS group_list=bh_class, queue=windfall, jobtype=cluster_only, select=1:ncpus=4:mem=15gb, pvmem=14gb, place=pack:shared, walltime=24:00:00, cput=24:00:00.

Configure script paths: CONTIG_DIR='/rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly/megahit-out', OUT_DIR='/rsgrps/bh_class/username/gene_finding', GENE_CALLS='$OUT_DIR/gene_calls', PROTEINS='$OUT_DIR/proteins.faa', NUCLEO='$OUT_DIR/nucleotides.faa', CONTIGS='$CONTIG_DIR/fixed-contigs.fa'.
The script must load prodigal/2.6.2 and run: prodigal -i $CONTIGS -o $GENE_CALLS -a $PROTEINS -d $NUCLEO
Make the script executable: chmod 755 run-prodigal.sh
Submit the job: qsub -e std-err/ -o std-out/ run-prodigal.sh
